private_state: Registry retains original nofollow file descriptors for nft, dynamic loader and complete actual ELF dependency closure, keyring/status/index witnesses and membership seal. DTO has no caller path/FD/signature authority; lookup checks exact registry identity. Returned RootResolvedHostTool duplicates executable FD; consumer owns duplicate, registry owns originals. package_set_receipt_handle is this opaque observation handle, never Coral PackageSetInstallReceipt. RootResolvedHostTool existing private path/fd/dev/inode fields retained; production verify_current delegates to registry all-file revalidation. Restart invalidates live handles; audit persistence is not bearer authority.
trust: Match actual /etc/os-release and installed dpkg package/architecture to exactly one closed variant. Debian VERSION_ID major13 plus trixie, Ubuntu24.04 plus noble. Read-only authenticated official index/cache chain InRelease signature -> Packages SHA -> exact deb SHA -> extracted executable/dependency member bytes -> actual root-owned installed bytes. No dpkg MD5-only, ldd execution, caller receipts/paths/mirrors/version, insecure apt flags/key import, package installation/upgrade/replacement. Dependencies include interpreter/loader and transitive ELF closure, each exact installed version authenticated by signed package evidence; absent evidence unavailable. Existing host distro keyring is a pre-existing OS trust anchor, not trust derived from caller source.
currentness: Lease <=30seconds and selected network/controller lease. Revalidate all held and current fixed-path inodes/hashes/root ownership/no group-world write, installed versions/status, keyring/signature metadata validity and exact selected variant/network/service generation before every nft check/apply/readback and network launch. No lease extension from copied DTO. Changed dependency/status/keyring or expired metadata denies. Download/cache observation bounded to selected exact packages only, no global apt update authority.
proof_limit: Measured archived package/source/executable is not installed host, running systemd/kernel feature, namespace/firewall functionality or acceptance proof. Actual host dependency observation and existing positive/negative kernel probes remain mandatory.
